title: Two mugs
logline: The kettle on the hot plate, two mugs on the drafting table — one his, one the chipped white enamel one that will be Chloe's in April, used first here. The editor's page with the editor out of frame.

panels.composition: A kettle on a hot plate in a garage and two mugs on a drafting table, one a chipped white enamel mug, a folder of pages beside them, lamplight, nobody.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a kettle on a hot plate in a garage studio and two mugs on a drafting table one of them a chipped white enamel mug, a folder of pages beside them, lamplight, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
